bio.en: I am a Machine Learning PhD student at MBZUAI, advised by Prof. Zhiqiang Shen. My long-term goal is to build agentic systems that can carry out arbitrary complex, long-horizon human expert work in digital environments, with a path toward real-world tasks. My current focus is production-grade models for agentic design and automated iteration systems for the long-horizon harnesses that support them.
bio.zh: 我是罗亚鑫，在 MBZUAI 攻读机器学习博士，导师是 Zhiqiang Shen 教授。我的长期目标是构建能够在数字世界中完成任意复杂、长程人类专家工作的智能体系统，并逐步探索扩展到真实世界任务。目前重点是让模型可靠完成生产级设计类 Agentic 任务，并构建支撑这些任务的长程 Harness 自动迭代系统。

description.en: I build production-grade models for agentic design and study post-training methods for high-quality, structured, editable artifacts, including scientific figures, posters, presentations, and web experiences. AutoDesign provides a concrete setting for this work.
description.zh: 我研究面向 Agentic Design 的模型与 post-training 方法，目标是生成高质量、结构化且可编辑的数字制品，包括科研绘图、海报、演示文稿和网页。AutoDesign 为这项工作提供了具体场景。

title.zh: 长程智能体任务后训练

description.en: I study post-training for long-horizon agentic tasks and build Agent Harnesses for multimodal design workflows. This includes reproducible execution, tool use, trajectory capture, automated evaluation, iterative optimization, and training pipelines informed by rollout evidence and evaluator feedback.
description.zh: 我研究长程智能体任务的 post-training，并为多模态设计工作流构建 Agent Harness，将任务执行、工具调用、轨迹采集、自动评测与迭代优化整合为可复现流程；同时利用 rollout 证据与评测反馈改进系统并支持后续模型训练。

role.en: Research Intern · Northern Dipper Talent Program

period.zh: 2026 年 9 月至今 · 中国北京

description.en: Research and build Agent Harnesses for long-horizon multimodal design tasks, integrating execution, tool use, trace capture, automated evaluation, and iterative optimization into a reproducible pipeline. Investigate harness automation and meta-optimization using rollout evidence, evaluator feedback, and component-level updates. Contribute to the full LongCat 2.5 post-training workflow for Agentic Design, from post-training harness design and training-oriented trajectory collection to Mid-Training, SFT, and RFT, studying how to internalize behaviors from harness trajectories in the model.
description.zh: 面向多模态长程设计任务研究并构建 Agent Harness，将任务执行、工具调用、轨迹记录、自动评测与迭代优化整合为可复现流程。探索 Harness 自动化与元优化，利用 rollout 证据、评测反馈和组件级更新提升长程任务的稳定交付能力。参与 LongCat 2.5 Agentic Design 任务后训练全流程，涵盖后训练 Harness 设计、面向训练的轨迹采集、Mid-Training、SFT 与 RFT，研究如何将 Harness 轨迹中的行为内化到模型中。

period.zh: 2026 年 4 月至 9 月 · 中国北京

description.en: Focused on AutoDesign and long-horizon design agents, developing reusable DesignHarnesses, evaluation protocols, and workflows around real deliverables.
description.zh: 聚焦 AutoDesign 与长程设计智能体，围绕真实交付物构建可复用的 DesignHarness、评测协议与工作流。

period.zh: 2025 年 1 月至 8 月 · 阿联酋阿布扎比

description.en: Advised by Prof. Zhiqiang Shen. Studied transfer of language-pretrained parameters to vision using label-free random-label bridge training, published at TMLR 2026. Built Open CaptchaWorld, an interactive multimodal browser-agent benchmark with 20 categories and 225 dynamic CAPTCHAs, accepted at NeurIPS 2025.
description.zh: 由 Zhiqiang Shen 教授指导，研究语言预训练参数向纯视觉任务的迁移，提出无需人工标注的随机标签桥接训练，相关工作发表于 TMLR 2026。构建 Open CaptchaWorld 多模态浏览器智能体交互基准，覆盖 20 类、225 个动态 CAPTCHA，被 NeurIPS 2025 接收。

description.en: Conference helper and session chair for the Smart Data workshop.
description.zh: 协助会议事务，并担任 Smart Data 研讨会的分会场主持。
协助 SciSec 2024 会议工作。

organization.en: Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University
organization.zh: 北京大学中国社会科学调查中心

description.en: Contributed to a public psychological healthcare project led by China’s Ministry of Civil Affairs.
description.zh: 参与由中国民政部牵头的公共心理健康项目。

organization.zh: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学（MBZUAI）

description.en: Advised by Prof. Zhiqiang Shen. Researching post-training for artifact design and long-horizon agentic tasks, with the long-term goal of enabling agents to carry out complex expert work in digital environments.
description.zh: 导师为 Zhiqiang Shen 教授，主要研究 artifact design 与长程智能体任务的 post-training，长期目标是让智能体能够在数字世界中完成复杂专家工作。

role.en: Bachelor of General Engineering · Machine Learning
role.zh: 通用工程学士 · 机器学习方向

description.en: Bachelor thesis advised by Prof. Dimitrios Papadopoulos. Collaborated with Dr. Gen Luo and Prof. Rongrong Ji on efficient deep learning during my undergraduate studies.
description.zh: 本科论文导师为 Dimitrios Papadopoulos 教授；本科期间也与 Gen Luo 博士和 Rongrong Ji 教授合作开展高效深度学习研究。

period.zh: 2020 年 9 月至 2021 年 4 月 · 本科学习经历

description.en: Studied pure mathematics and physics, with an early fascination for string theory. My tutor Prof. Ana Rita Pires helped turn that curiosity into a commitment to research. I later changed major and country; no Edinburgh degree was completed.
description.zh: 学习纯数学与物理，曾对弦理论充满好奇。导师 Ana Rita Pires 教授的鼓励与支持，让这份好奇逐渐转化为科研志向。之后我更换专业与国家，未在爱丁堡完成学位。

role.en: Biomedicine and an Early Business Chapter
role.zh: 生物医学与早期商业经历

organization.zh: 昆士兰大学 · 布里斯班

period.zh: 爱丁堡之前 · 原站未记录日期

description.en: I enrolled in biomedicine and prepared for medical-school admission while managing a multi-brand boutique in Brisbane’s South Bank. That early business-focused chapter preceded the shift toward science and research in Edinburgh.
description.zh: 我曾就读生物医学并准备医学院入学，同时在布里斯班南岸经营一家多品牌服装精品店。这段更关注商业的早期经历，发生在爱丁堡的学习让我转向科学研究之前。

title.en: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
title.zh: AutoDesign：面向长程智能体设计的 Meta-Harness 优化

publications.authors: Yaxin Luo*, Haobin Jiang*, Jialv Zou, Xu Huang, Wenhao Yan, Haodong Li, Zhengrong Yue, Jing Li, Xiaofu Chen, Xiaohan Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaotong Li

summary.en: Meta-Harness Optimization improves a reusable DesignHarness through rollout evidence, evaluation, and acceptance gates. On the 100-paper PosterBench, the reported best score is 78.32, 7.45 points above Claude Design under the matched configuration; gains across seven matched configurations range from 5.01 to 19.56 points.
summary.zh: AutoDesign 使用可复用的 DesignHarness、rollout 证据、评测与接受门控研究长程智能体设计。在 100 篇论文的 PosterBench 上，公开结果最高为 78.32 分，较同配置 Claude Design 高 7.45 分；7 组匹配配置的增益为 5.01–19.56 分。

title.en: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs: Leveraging the Cognitive Gap for Scalable and Diverse GUI-Agent Defense
title.zh: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs：利用认知差异构建可扩展、多样化的 GUI 智能体防御

publications.authors: Jiacheng Liu*, Yaxin Luo*, Jiacheng Cui, Xinyi Shang, Xiaohan Zhao, Zhiqiang Shen

summary.en: An interactive CAPTCHA defense framework that examines human–agent differences in perception, memory, decision-making, and action. Its dynamic tasks explore where human intuition and current GUI-agent capabilities diverge.
summary.zh: 一套交互式验证码防御框架，研究人与智能体在感知、记忆、决策和行动上的差异，通过动态任务探索人类直觉与当前 GUI 智能体能力之间的差距。

title.en: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
title.zh: LLMSurgeon：诊断大语言模型的训练数据配比

publications.authors: Yaxin Luo*, Jiacheng Cui*, Xiaohan Zhao, Xinyi Shang, Jiacheng Liu, Xinyue Bi, Zhaoyi Li, Zhiqiang Shen

summary.en: Studies how generated text can help estimate an LLM’s pretraining-domain mixture under a predefined taxonomy and label-shift assumption. LLMSurgeon formulates a calibrated inverse problem and introduces the LLMScan evaluation suite.
summary.zh: 研究在预定义领域分类与标签偏移假设下，如何利用生成文本估计大模型预训练数据的领域配比。LLMSurgeon 将其建模为校准后的逆问题，并提出 LLMScan 评估套件。

title.en: Language-Pretraining-Induced Bias: A Strong Foundation for General Vision Tasks
title.zh: 语言预训练诱导的偏置：通用视觉任务的有力基础

summary.en: Random-label bridge training adapts language-pretrained parameters to vision without manual labels during the bridge stage. The reported language-induced prior accelerates convergence and improves CIFAR-100 test accuracy by 2.4 percentage points.
summary.zh: 通过无需人工标注的随机标签桥接训练，将语言预训练参数适配到视觉任务。论文报告语言诱导偏置可加速视觉任务收敛，并在 CIFAR-100 上带来 2.4 个百分点的测试准确率提升。

title.en: Open CaptchaWorld: A Comprehensive Web-based Platform for Testing and Benchmarking Multimodal LLM Agents
title.zh: Open CaptchaWorld：用于测试与评估多模态大模型智能体的综合网页平台

publications.authors: Yaxin Luo*, Zhaoyi Li*, Jiacheng Liu, Jiacheng Cui, Xiaohan Zhao, Zhiqiang Shen

summary.en: A dynamic web CAPTCHA benchmark spanning 20 categories and 225 tasks, with the CAPTCHA Reasoning Depth metric. The reported human success rate is 93.3%, compared with 40.0% for the strongest evaluated agent, exposing gaps in perception, reasoning, and sustained interaction.
summary.zh: 动态网页 CAPTCHA 基准，覆盖 20 类、225 个任务，并提出 CAPTCHA Reasoning Depth 指标。论文报告人类成功率为 93.3%，最佳受测智能体为 40.0%，揭示感知、推理与长程交互能力之间的差距。

title.en: γ-MoD: Exploring Mixture-of-Depth Adaptation for Multimodal Large Language Models
title.zh: γ-MoD：探索多模态大语言模型的混合深度适配

publications.authors: Yaxin Luo, Gen Luo, Jiayi Ji, Yiyi Zhou, Xiaoshuai Sun, Zhiqiang Shen, Rongrong Ji

summary.en: Adapts dense multimodal models to selective computation. Attention-map rank identifies candidate layers, while shared vision–language routing and masked routing learning help tokens skip unnecessary computation.
summary.zh: 将稠密多模态模型适配为选择性计算模型：利用注意力图的秩识别候选层，再结合视觉语言共享路由与掩码路由学习，让 token 跳过不必要的计算。

title.en: APL: Anchor-Based Prompt Learning for One-Stage Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
title.zh: APL：用于单阶段弱监督指代表达理解的锚点提示学习

publications.authors: Yaxin Luo, Jiayi Ji, Xiaofu Chen, Yuxin Zhang, Tianhe Ren, Gen Luo

summary.en: Position, color, and category prompts enrich anchor features for weakly supervised visual grounding. Text reconstruction and visual alignment achieve state-of-the-art results on four REC benchmarks, with a reported 6.44% improvement over RefCLIP on RefCOCO.
summary.zh: 通过位置、颜色与类别提示增强锚点特征，结合文本重建与视觉对齐目标，在四个 REC 基准上达到 SOTA；论文报告 RefCOCO 相对 RefCLIP 提升 6.44%。

title.en: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
title.zh: AutoDesign：面向长程智能体设计的 Meta-Harness 优化

projects.authors: Yaxin Luo*, Haobin Jiang*, Jialv Zou, Xu Huang, Wenhao Yan, Haodong Li, Zhengrong Yue, Jing Li, Xiaofu Chen, Xiaohan Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaotong Li

summary.en: Meta-Harness Optimization improves a reusable DesignHarness through rollout evidence, evaluation, and acceptance gates. On the 100-paper PosterBench, the reported best score is 78.32, 7.45 points above Claude Design under the matched configuration; gains across seven matched configurations range from 5.01 to 19.56 points.
summary.zh: AutoDesign 使用可复用的 DesignHarness、rollout 证据、评测与接受门控研究长程智能体设计。在 100 篇论文的 PosterBench 上，公开结果最高为 78.32 分，较同配置 Claude Design 高 7.45 分；7 组匹配配置的增益为 5.01–19.56 分。

question.en: How can a design agent improve the reusable system around it, beyond revising one artifact?
question.zh: 设计智能体如何超越单次改稿，改进可以重复使用的设计系统？

approach.en: A model-agnostic DesignHarness supports Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code and other coding harnesses. The inner Designer–Critic loop refines native artifacts; outer Meta-Harness Optimization uses traces, evaluators and persistent optimization records to update reusable infrastructure, with acceptance gates preventing regressions.
approach.zh: 模型无关的 DesignHarness 支持 Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code 等 coding harness。内层 Designer–Critic 迭代原生产物，外层 Meta-Harness Optimization 基于轨迹、评测器与持久优化记录更新可复用系统，并通过接受门控约束回退。

output.en: Editable posters, slides, webpages and captioned videos. On the 100-paper PosterBench, public results reach 78.32: 7.45 points above Claude Design in the matched configuration, with gains of 5.01–19.56 points across seven matched configurations. These quantitative results concern posters; the other formats are demonstrated outputs.
output.zh: 可编辑海报、幻灯片、网页与带字幕视频。在 100 篇论文的 PosterBench 上，公开结果最高为 78.32 分，较同配置 Claude Design 高 7.45 分，7 组匹配配置增益为 5.01–19.56 分。这些量化结果针对海报；其他格式提供真实产物示例。

title.zh: FigMirror：参考图驱动的科研绘图智能体

contribution.en: Authored early specifications for the method, Web UI, and multi-round refinement. Added Codex and Claude runners, event-bus and session-state coverage, and refinement integration tests to establish a verifiable baseline for subsequent agent iterations.
contribution.zh: 负责早期方法、Web UI 与多轮 refinement 的项目规格，并补充 Codex / Claude runner、事件总线、会话状态和 refine 集成测试，为后续智能体迭代建立可验证的基线。

question.en: How can an agent turn data and a visual reference into an editable, publication-ready figure?
question.zh: 智能体如何将数据与视觉参考转化为可编辑、可发表的科研图表？

approach.en: Orchestrator–Drawer–Reviewer roles coordinate a reference-driven plotting workflow. Grounded Measurement and multi-round refinement guide the conversion of user data into editable Matplotlib code.
approach.zh: 通过 Orchestrator–Drawer–Reviewer 角色分工组织参考图驱动的绘图流程，结合 Grounded Measurement 与多轮 refinement，将用户数据转化为可编辑 Matplotlib 代码。

output.en: Editable Matplotlib source and camera-ready PDFs. The image shown here is an actual generated output from the official FigMirror showcase.
output.zh: 可编辑 Matplotlib 源代码与可直接用于论文的 PDF。这里展示的图片来自 FigMirror 官方 showcase 的真实生成产物。

caption.en: An actual generated figure from the official project showcase. The source repository presents its reference and output together.
caption.zh: 官方项目 showcase 中的真实生成图表；来源仓库同时提供参考图与生成结果。
